[{"streamId":"01a1881b-9fb6-72fb-bf76-bfbf07854c85","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881b-9fb6-72fb-bf76-bfbf07854c85\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022TrackerClaimGate.Gates admits a linear reference, so with --claim-gate tracker-assignee a task linked to a Linear issue is claimed on this install only while Linear shows the issue assigned to this install\\u0027s viewer id; the dispatcher, h9k task drive, h9k task start, and h9k task queue all read it through that one gate, and a project with the gate off is untouched\u0022,\u0022The identity compared is the viewer\\u0027s user id recorded on the Linear connection, compared ordinally, never the name or the email; a connection that carries none reads it from viewer once and records it on the connection\\u0027s stream, as the Jira path does for accountId; Linear\\u0027s delegate field is neither read nor written\u0022,\u0022The three read failures map for Linear with their own remedies: a rejected key maps to Credentials and the remedy names h9k connection add linear; an issue Linear answers not found or not visible maps to Item and the remedy defers to Linear\\u0027s own words plus the moved-team relink hint A defines; a 429 RATELIMITED, a 5xx, a timeout, or an unreachable host maps to Outage and waits for the next sweep; an HTTP 200 carrying an errors array is never read as an assignment\u0022,\u0022h9k task queue \\u003Cid\\u003E --take and h9k task assign \\u003Cid\\u003E --take on a Linear issue the fresh read shows assigned to nobody write the viewer id through issueUpdate\\u0027s assigneeId, read the issue back, record TrackerAssignmentWritten from that read-back, and proceed; an issue somebody else holds is refused exactly as today with nothing written (piece E changes that refusal); an issue already yours records TrackerAssignmentObserved and proceeds; the write touches no state, label, or other field\u0022,\u0022Because Linear\\u0027s assignee is single-valued, the Linear take follows Jira\\u0027s overwrite shape and never GitHub\\u0027s add-assignee shape, so a Contested verdict cannot arise from it, and a test pins the read-back comparison on the user id\u0022,\u0022TrackerAssignmentTake.ReleaseAsync clears a Linear issue\\u0027s assignee (assigneeId null) only when the fresh read shows this install\\u0027s own viewer id on it, confirms by read-back, and answers NothingToDo for an issue held by nobody or by somebody else\u0022,\u0022The claim-time assign mirror (DispatchEngine.MirrorTrackerAssigneeBestEffortAsync) and the release mirror on lease expiry and at closeout run for a Linear issue on every project, with the existing TaskTrackerAssignMirrorPending and TaskTrackerReleaseMirrorPending rows retrying a write that did not land on the existing backoff\u0022,\u0022The Jira-else-GitHub branches touched here (TrackerClaimGate.Gates and CheckAsync, TrackerAssignmentTake.TakeAsync, GrantToAsync, and ReleaseAsync) become three-way provider switches, so a Linear reference never falls into the GitHub branch, and GrantToAsync moves a Linear issue from unassigned or from this install\\u0027s own id to the grantee\\u0027s id for the cooperative take\u0022,\u0022Every sentence the gate and the take print for a Linear issue names Linear as the tracker, the identifier as the item, and the issue\\u0027s web URL in the assign-yourself lever, and a refused claim publishes the same TrackerClaimHold row h9k status reads today\u0022,\u0022Every Linear call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and the take\\u0027s read-write-read sequence is pinned by a test that records the requests made\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:25:26.051089\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"0348f362-0a99-4748-94ce-5513fb30615e","originSequence":145458,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:25:26.064337+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881b-a250-7546-898c-74cb1f3e070c","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881b-a250-7546-898c-74cb1f3e070c\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022PullRequestBody.Title puts the Linear identifier at the front of the pull request title once, exactly as a Jira key is placed today (whole-token check, an authored title that already starts with the identifier kept as written), and a GitHub issue number still gets no prefix\u0022,\u0022The work-item line on the body renders a Linear link as [ENG-123](\\u003Cissue web URL\\u003E) with no magic word before it, so it mentions the issue without instructing Linear\u0022,\u0022RelayedText.WithoutClosingKeywords also defuses Linear\\u0027s closing words (close, fix, resolve, complete, and implement in every form Linear lists, plus the phrase linear issue) when followed by a Linear identifier or a Linear issue URL, and the {TEAM}-NEW form that creates an issue, by the same backtick wrapping the GitHub rule uses and idempotently; the title, the objective seed, each criterion, the authored body, and the agent summary all pass through it, and a test pins each against the composed title and body\u0022,\u0022A non-closing or relation phrase (ref, refs, references, part of, contributes to, toward, towards, relates to, related to) before an identifier is left alone, because it changes no issue state on merge\u0022,\u0022Closeout posts no comment to a Linear issue and changes no Linear state: a test pins CloseoutEngine.TellTheCardAsync making no Linear call for a linear reference, and the close-linked-issue rule stays GitHub-only\u0022,\u0022LinkedWorkItemImport finds a Linear identifier in a pull request\\u0027s title or body only against the team keys the workspace actually has, read through the install\\u0027s Linear connection at scan time, so an issue from a team other than the project\\u0027s default is found and a token that merely looks like a key (UTF-8, SHA-256, CVE-2024-1) is not; with no Linear connection the scan links nothing, exactly as an unbound Jira board links nothing today\u0022,\u0022Because hall9k relies on Linear\\u0027s branch-name linking and writes no magic word, h9k doctor warns when a Linear-tracked project\\u0027s branch template carries no {key} token, naming h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --branch-template \\u0022{key}-{slug}\\u0022; the default task/{shortid}-{slug} template produces a branch Linear never links\u0022,\u0022Every Linear call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and no test opens a pull request or touches GitHub\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:25:27.279903\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"d6589f00-a994-4a46-8ba8-7604927d1bef","originSequence":145459,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:25:27.293277+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881b-eb81-71d9-99e6-7b4ade1f4613","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881b-eb81-71d9-99e6-7b4ade1f4613\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --backlog linear is accepted only when the project has a Linear team bound, refused otherwise naming h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear \\u003CTEAM\\u003E; BacklogPolicy gains Linear and its parse error names all four values\u0022,\u0022With the policy linear, h9k task publish on a draft that carries no linked issue and has no publication pending refuses before publishing with the three existing choices: link one with h9k task link-linear, attest none exists with --no-existing-item, or skip tracking with --untracked; the refusal names Linear and the link-linear command\u0022,\u0022Publishing with --no-existing-item creates the issue after the publish transaction commits, deterministically and with no agent session, through issueCreate with the team (the project\\u0027s default team, or --linear-team \\u003CTEAM\\u003E for this one publish, checked against Linear and refused when unknown), the title (the objective folded to one line), and a markdown description composed the way GitHubIssueBody.Compose composes an issue body (agent context, the acceptance-criteria checklist, and the full objective when the title was cut); no state is passed, so the issue lands in the team\\u0027s default backlog state; the created issue is read back and linked through the same path h9k task link-linear uses, and the task record is then written to the ledger\u0022,\u0022Publishing with --untracked publishes with no Linear issue, records the choice on TaskPublished as it does for Jira and GitHub, and the note names Linear; a task adopted or linked earlier publishes without creating anything\u0022,\u0022Publish never files a second issue for one task: a task that already carries a reference or a pending publication creates nothing, and a create whose read-back or link failed is reported with h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier\\u003E as the remedy (a create that itself failed names a by-hand create instead) and is never retried by the platform\u0022,\u0022Linear labels, Linear projects, and cycles are not set on a created issue; --backlog-routing is ignored under the linear policy and h9k project set says so when it is set together with linear\u0022,\u0022Every Linear call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and a test pins the exact issueCreate request for a sample task\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:25:28.504384\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"17dc108e-fa9b-4c03-9564-2ea8a27db821","originSequence":145460,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:25:28.516463+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022When an interactive h9k task queue or h9k task assign (with --take, or without it where the door already offers a take) reads the linked item assigned to another person, it names that person as the tracker shows them and asks whether to reassign the item to the operator, defaulting to no; on yes it reads the item fresh again and, only if the same holder is still there, writes the operator\\u0027s own tracker identity through the tracker API, reads it back, and proceeds exactly as a take does; on no it warns and proceeds as today\u0022,\u0022The offer is made only where a human is at the terminal: a non-interactive run, the dispatcher\\u0027s claim and mirror sweeps, a dispatched session, and an orchestrator session never reassign, and a non-interactive --take on a held item refuses exactly as today\u0022,\u0022No reassignment is offered when the task\\u0027s ledger holder is another node (TaskAggregate.HolderNodeId names a node other than this one): the refusal names that node and points at the cooperative take, h9k task take \\u003Cid\\u003E --reason \\u0022\\u003Cwhy\\u003E\\u0022, whose grant moves the tracker assignment\u0022,\u0022A fresh read whose holder differs from the one named in the question writes nothing and says who holds the item now\u0022,\u0022The reassignment is recorded on the task\\u0027s stream as its own event carrying who was replaced (identity and name as the tracker showed them), who replaced them, the reference, and when it was read back; h9k task show renders it\u0022,\u0022It works for every gated tracker: Linear and Jira overwrite the single assignee; on GitHub every current assignee is removed and the operator added, so the read-back shows the operator alone, and a read-back that still names anybody else refuses as Contested with nothing recorded\u0022,\u0022The item\\u0027s state, labels, and other fields are untouched; the write is an assignee field update only\u0022,\u0022The --take help text, the refusal sentences, and the CLI reference skill no longer say that no flag takes an item from another person; they say an interactive confirm can, and that nothing unattended does\u0022,\u0022Every tracker call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and the offer, its decline, and its acceptance are pinned through the existing TakeOffer seam without a console\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:26:15.820157\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"0101b902-00cc-4305-b731-306859bba004","originSequence":145461,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:26:15.833086+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881b-a597-7689-bb60-19a7c74503a2","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881b-a597-7689-bb60-19a7c74503a2\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022h9k idea add --from-linear \\u003Cidentifier or URL\\u003E (and --from-jira \\u003Ckey or URL\\u003E, --from-issue \\u003Cnumber or URL\\u003E) reads the item through the install\\u0027s connection for that tracker, captures an idea whose text is the item\\u0027s title folded to one line with closing words defused (TaskAddCommand.ObjectiveSeed\\u0027s rule), writes the item\\u0027s title, description, URL, and observed state into the idea\\u0027s workspace as a file, and records the link on the idea\\u0027s stream as \\u003Cprovider\\u003E:\\u003Creference\\u003E with the observed title, state, and time, as WorkItemLinked records it on a task\u0022,\u0022The text argument is optional with a --from flag and defaults to the title; when given it wins; two --from flags together are refused\u0022,\u0022Idea adoption accepts the states task adoption accepts plus Linear\\u0027s triage; completed, canceled, and duplicate Linear issues, closed GitHub issues, and done Jira cards are refused with the state named\u0022,\u0022An idea with a tracker link needs a project at capture (--project, or the refusal names it), the project\\u0027s one tracker must match the link\\u0027s provider (refused naming the project\\u0027s tracker, as A refuses a task), and h9k idea move onto a project whose tracker differs is refused the same way\u0022,\u0022One item, one idea: a second idea from an item another live idea carries is refused naming that idea, and an item a task already holds is refused naming the task\u0022,\u0022h9k idea show renders the link as the item\\u0027s web URL, h9k idea list shows its key, and the link replicates with the idea like its other events\u0022,\u0022The first h9k task add --from-idea on a linked idea adopts the item exactly as h9k task add --from-\\u003Ctracker\\u003E would: the same refusals (RefuseSecondAdoptionAsync, the ledger\\u0027s cross-node check, the one-tracker rule), the same WorkItemLinked, the item\\u0027s title and description as agent context, and every job the link carries (claim gate, branch key, PR title, publish gate); the cut still needs its own --objective\u0022,\u0022A later cut from the same idea while a task from it still holds the item (any state but Abandoned, as the guard already reads it) is created unlinked rather than refused, and the output names the holding task and the epic route: carry the item in the sibling\\u0027s context, publish it --untracked, and group the tasks under an epic linked to the item\u0022,\u0022h9k epic link-linear \\u003Cepic\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier or URL\\u003E records the identifier verbatim and unverified on the epic, identity only, exactly as h9k epic link-jira does\u0022,\u0022Every tracker call in these tests runs against recorded responses\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:26:16.937386\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"b743ba08-e7b6-4528-856e-a8ad14a21ba8","originSequence":145462,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:26:16.949242+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
